 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception  enum value  DROP_DATA_VALUE_HS_ERROR

 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception  rand bit [7:1]   drop_lpdt_bit = 7'b1111_111; Bit vector value is only considered when error kind is DROP_BITS_IN_ESC_LPDT_BYTE_ERROR. Respective bit element value will indicate whether that bit will be dropped in respective LPDT byte transmission or not. drop_lpdt_bit[1] == 1 : Bit 1 of respective LPDT byte will be dropped. drop_lpdt_bit[1] == 0 : Bit 1 of respective LPDT byte will not be dropped. Same way other bits value of drop_lpdt_bit will be consider to drop or not drop the respective bits in LPDT byte. Note: LPDT byte Bit 0 is excluded from dropping, because internal model has dependency on this. Default is 7'b1111_111.

 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception  rand bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  lane_error_enable = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'hF; Specifies lane error enable value. Respective bit value [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES(4) - 1):0] indicates which lane error injection is enabled. lane_error_enable [0] = 1 : Indicates Lane zero error injection is enabled. lane_error_enable [0] = 0 : Indicates Lane zero error injection is not enabled. Note: Same definition should be considered for lane_error_enable[(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES(4) - 1):1] values. Also lane_error_enable value should be non-zero. Default value is 4'hF, all lane error injection is enabled.

 svt_sequence_item_base  static int  max_array_elem_display = SVT_MAX_ARRAY_ELEM_DISPLAY_DEFAULT; Used by all svt_data derived display methods to limit the number of array entries which are displayed whenever an array data member is displayed. If the number of array elements is less than or equal to the max_array_elem_display value or max_array_elem_display is set to -1, then all array elements are displayed. If max_array_elem_display is set to 0, then only the array size will be displayed. Otherwise max_array_elem_display array elements are displayed. Since this field is not owned by an individual instance, it is not copied, compared, etc., like the other svt_data properties. Initial value set to SVT_MAX_ARRAY_ELEM_DISPLAY_DEFAULT so it can be overridden at compile time.

 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception  rand int unsigned  post_error_range_max = 1; Specifies the maximum range value up to which the Post symbols are corrupted. Post pattern range from 7 symbols to 224 symbols based on configuration attribute tgr_post_length[4:0] value. post_error_range_max value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 223rd symbol and it should be greater or equal to post_error_range_min. Default value is 1. 
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception  rand int unsigned  post_error_range_min = 0; Specifies the minimum range value from where the Post symbols are corrupted. Post pattern range from 7 symbols to 224 symbols based on configuration attribute tgr_post_length[4:0] value. post_error_range_min value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 223rd symbol and it should be smaller or equal to post_error_range_max. Default value is 0. 
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception  rand bit [1:0]   post_error_value = 0; Specifies the Post symbol error value. error_kind == RAND_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between post_error_range_min and post_error_range_max range, random corrupted value will be transmitted. error_kind == USER_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between post_error_range_min and post_error_range_max range, post_error_value value will be transmitted. This error will be injected only when t3_post_error_value size == 0. Default value is 0.

Pre-begin pattern range from 7 symbols to 448 symbols based on configuration attribute tgr_preamble_length[5:0] value. pre_begin_error_range_max value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 447th symbol and it should be greater or equal to pre_begin_error_range_min. Default value is 1. 
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception  rand int unsigned  pre_begin_error_range_min = 0; Specifies the minimum range value from where the Pre-begin symbols are corrupted. Pre-begin pattern range from 7 symbols to 448 symbols based on configuration attribute tgr_preamble_length[5:0] value. pre_begin_error_range_min value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 447th symbol and it should be smaller or equal to pre_begin_error_range_max. Default value is 0. 
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception  rand bit [2:0]   pre_begin_error_value = 0; Specifies the Pre-begin symbol error value. error_kind == RAND_PRE_BEGIN_SOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between pre_begin_error_range_min and pre_begin_error_range_max range, random corrupted(excluding 3) value will be transmitted. error_kind == USER_PRE_BEGIN_SOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between pre_begin_error_range_min and pre_begin_error_range_max range, pre_begin_error_value value will be transmitted. Default value is 0.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception  rand bit [6:0]   pre_end_error_mask_value = 1; Specifies mask for Pre-end 7 symbol value. Respective bit value [6:0] indicates which Pre-end symbol will be corrupted. pre_end_error_mask_value[0] = 1 : Indicates Pre-end symbol zero will be corrupted by pre_end_error_value[0]. pre_end_error_mask_value[0] = 0 : Indicates Pre-end symbol zero will not be corrupted by pre_end_error_value[0]. Note: Same definition should be consider for pre_end_error_mask_value[7:1] values. Default value is 1.  
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception  rand bit [2:0]   pre_end_error_value [6:0] = { 1 , 1 , 4 , 2 , 1 , 2 , 2 }; Random/User specific Pre-end error value, considered only when error_kind 'PRE_END_SOT_HS_ERROR'. Based on pre_end_error_mask_value & pre_end_error_value, Pre-end will be transmitted. Default value is {1,1,4,2,1,2,2}.
